label: Inside word-for-word stock boilerplate the model knows by heart, peaking on a small word or comma mid-passage: open-source license text (GPL 'but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty', MIT 'without restriction, including without limitation'), browser user-agent strings ('(KHTML, like Gecko)'), and book copyright notices ('No part of this publication may be reproduced, stored in a retrieval system'). Quiet for the same words (without, like, commas) in ordinary sentences and for freshly made-up legal-sounding clauses (leases, club rules). Side case: the Spanish word 'toponimia' (place-name study) also fires, weaker.
